parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key. Join metabolism to compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id. Join compound_structures on compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. LEFT JOIN molecule_hierarchy on compound_records.molregno = molecule_hierarchy.molregno, then LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary on molecule_hierarchy.parent_molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno to get parent_compound_name from molecule_dictionary.pref_name. Derive substrate_compound_name from compound_records.compound_name. Do not deduplicate. Do not add ORDER BY. Limit to first 200 rows.
